# The upload abort signal reaches XHR rather than every upload stage

The worker failure path aborts a shared controller. The bucket sendBlob path forwards its signal to uploadWithTracker, whose XHR abort listener rejects and removes the listener on terminal events. The legacy non-bucket upload, encryption, storage polling and metadata calls do not receive that signal here. Workers are still awaited before best-effort ID cleanup; pagehide starts a separate unawaited keepalive cleanup request. These source paths do not establish prompt all-stage cancellation, delivered teardown cleanup or server deletion. The accepted source later removes the legacy branch.

Scope: Thundermail generated upload cancellation and cleanup boundary.
